current_article.title: Community Day Classic: Back to Bulbasaur — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
Community Day Classic: Back to Bulbasaur
Community Day Classic: Back to Bulbasaur
Saturday, January 22, 2022, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time
Trainers,
Return to the roots of Community Day during the Season of Heritage! As a special treat, we’ll be holding Community Day Classic and bringing back a favorite: Bulbasaur!
Featured Pokémon
Bulbasaur will be appearing more frequently in the wild!
Bulbasaur
: If you’re lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!
Exclusive Attack
Evolve Ivysaur (Bulbasaur’s Evolution) during the event or up to two hours afterward to get a Venusaur that knows the Charged Attack Frenzy Plant.
Venusaur
Venusaur will be able to learn the Charged Attack Frenzy Plant.
Frenzy Plant
Trainer Battles : 100 Power
Gyms and raids : 100 Power
Community Day Special Research Story: Bulbasaur Community Day Classic
For US$1.00 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access the Bulbasaur Community Day Classic–exclusive Special Research story: Bulbasaur Community Day Classic.
Stay tuned for when tickets for the Bulbasaur Community Day Classic Special Research story go live!
Tickets are nonrefundable (subject to applicable law and the exceptions set forth in the Terms of Service). Please note that this Special Research will not include an in-game medal.
Event Bonuses
3× Catch XP
Incense activated during the event will last for three hours
Lure Modules activated during the event will last for three hours
Take a few snapshots during Community Day for a surprise!
Event Bundles
There’ll be a special one-time-purchase Community Day Box available for 1,280 PokéCoins, featuring 50 Ultra Balls, five Lucky Eggs, five Star Pieces, and an Elite Charged TM.
30 Ultra Balls will be available in the shop at no cost. Be sure to pick them up during the event!
Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated. For the latest on in-game events and feature updates, be sure to check this help center article .
—The Pokémon GO team
